verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own docs show user-configured function pipelines whose declarative output Crossplane applies automatically. The control plane auto-corrects drift from desired state, and an opt-in 'real time compositions' flag suggests reconciliation reacting to resource changes. However, the pack never documents explicit event-to-action rules or triggers; automation is implied through continuous reconciliation rather than user-defined event rules. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger or rule definitions (e.g. watch-on-event actions), detail on what realtime compositions react to, examples of event-driven workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
